description.value: Starting at 13th level, a geomancer benefits from Blindsense out to 30 feet while in any favored terrain she has chosen. Blindsense lets the geomancer notice things it cannot see, but without the precision of blindsight, and usually does not require Perception checks to notice and locate creatures within range, provided line of effect. Any opponent the geomancer cannot see has total concealment (50% miss chance) against her, and normal miss chance applies when attacking foes with concealment. She is still denied her Dexterity bonus to AC against attacks from creatures she cannot see.
